timing_policy: Nested phases and simultaneous Map/Game startup must not be added as serial wall time.
Native startup and READY event clocks are distinct from observer arrival and fresh Android display.
Cold means a new destination process, not a proven cold filesystem cache.
Resident Atlas return reuses the original native MapServer process and cannot qualify fresh warm-cache process startup.
Map startup observation is a later sampled upper bound; epoch phase fields and console initialization have different scopes.
Untimestamped markers give ordering and bounded intervals only.
